scope: Theorem 4.7 (Discretized planar Furstenberg estimate) of the manuscript “Critical local smoothing for the three-dimensional wave equation” (preprints/Critical-local-smoothing-for-the-three-dimensional-wave-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 079 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79299093c07ea305), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 50. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let 0 < a ≤ 1, 0 < b ≤ 2, and ω > 0. There are σ > 0 and ∆0 > 0 with the following property. Work in fixed bounded coordinate charts for points and affine lines in the plane. Suppose that a probability measure ν on lines satisfies ν(B(ℓ, r)) ≤ ∆−σ rb (∆ ≤ r ≤ 1). For every line in its support, suppose that a probability measure µℓ on a set Pℓ within distance C∆ of that line satisfies, uniformly in ℓ, µℓ(B(x, r)) ≤ ∆−σ ra (∆ ≤ r ≤ 1). If 0 < ∆ < ∆0, then [ ℓ Pℓ ∆ ≥ ∆−F(a,b)+ω , F(a, b) = a + min{1, b, (a + b)/2}. (RW) Here | · |∆ denotes covering number; the constants may depend on the fixed charts and on C.
